import django
from django.conf import settings

settings.configure(
    DEBUG=True,
    DATABASES={'default': {'ENGINE': 'django.db.backends.sqlite3', 'NAME': ':memory:'}},
    INSTALLED_APPS=[
        'django.contrib.admin',
        'django.contrib.auth',
        'django.contrib.contenttypes',
        'django.contrib.sessions',
        'django.contrib.messages',
    ],
    ROOT_URLCONF=None,
)
django.setup()

from django.db import models, connection
from django.contrib import admin
from django.contrib.admin.helpers import AdminReadonlyField
from django import forms


class Related(models.Model):
    name = models.CharField(max_length=20)

    class Meta:
        app_label = 'repro'


class Main(models.Model):
    rel = models.ForeignKey(Related, on_delete=models.CASCADE)

    class Meta:
        app_label = 'repro'


custom_site = admin.AdminSite(name='custom-admin')


class RelatedAdmin(admin.ModelAdmin):
    pass


custom_site.register(Related, RelatedAdmin)


class MainAdmin(admin.ModelAdmin):
    readonly_fields = ['rel']


with connection.schema_editor() as se:
    se.create_model(Related)
    se.create_model(Main)

rel_obj = Related.objects.create(name='r1')
main_obj = Main.objects.create(rel=rel_obj)

main_admin = MainAdmin(Main, custom_site)

form_class = main_admin.get_form(None, main_obj)
form = form_class(instance=main_obj)

readonly_field = AdminReadonlyField(form, 'rel', is_first=True, model_admin=main_admin)

remote_field = Main._meta.get_field('rel').remote_field
html = readonly_field.get_admin_url(remote_field, rel_obj)
print(html)
assert '/custom-admin/' in html, "URL does not point to custom admin site!"
print("OK")

import sys
import types
from django.urls import path

urls_module = types.ModuleType('repro_urls')
urls_module.urlpatterns = [
    path('admin/', admin.site.urls),
    path('custom-admin/', custom_site.urls),
]
sys.modules['repro_urls'] = urls_module
settings.ROOT_URLCONF = 'repro_urls'
